name: Giant Rat
status: Registered normal-play mount; universal grants follow the normal server mount catalogue policy
source: Existing Meshy Dock Rat; no new provider generation or upload
preparation: Reuse the existing 4000-triangle imported rat surface and textures
Remove the rejected automatic rig; prepare a static neutral source with smooth normals
Normalize the exported surface to a 1.45 metre height and centre the body separately from its curled tail
Fit a dedicated 23-joint mount skeleton with complete paw, head and tail ownership
Author in-place idle, normal walk and fast scurry loops with fixed-world paw orientation and a coherent tail wave
Revision 2: smooth and tuck the malformed whisker clumps into a closed muzzle; repair their baked colour/normal islands including filter padding
Revision 2: rigidly attach the complete lips, chin and cheeks to the skull, protecting original anatomical witnesses from foreleg motion
Revision 2: uncurl the physical tail behind the rump, preserving its proximal attachment, guide segment lengths, cross-section offsets and unrelated body surface
Losslessly drop unreachable source buffers without changing any animation keys

Revision 3: reduce the outward bend at the tail base; protect the 17 original attachment seam vertices and blend the adjacent tube rings toward a straighter posterior rest. Preserve the reviewed mouth, rider fit and inherited gait motion.

contract.kind: mount-only asset, not a combat creature

publication: The normal client model/profile registries and capability handshake include Giant Rat. The server grants it through the existing all-mounts policy; selection and riding remain server-authoritative.
